name: Start node
description: Start the REM/Reticulum node and confirm the app is not in Not Ready state.
notes: Record troubleshooting steps if not Ready.

name: Confirm call sign
description: Verify the call sign is correct and recognizable to the trusted group.
notes: Use names the group understands under stress.

name: Announce
description: Send an announce so trusted peers can discover or refresh your presence.
completion_evidence: Announce sent and peer sees device
notes: Confirm both sides save/select if needed.

name: Send chat
description: Send a short direct chat message to a selected peer.
notes: Use a simple phrase like “comms drill message.”

name: Send MECP test
description: Send a drill/test Event using MECP and verify peers understand the plain-language meaning.
notes: Use Drill/Test category, not real emergency category.

name: Confirm ACK or response
description: Confirm each participant saw the message, responded, or otherwise acknowledged receipt.

name: Telemetry test
description: If enabled, confirm the map shows fresh location or that telemetry is intentionally disabled.
completion_evidence: Fresh position seen or privacy choice confirmed

name: Checklist update test
description: Create or update a checklist item and confirm the update is shared with intended peers.
notes: Useful to test operational task sharing.

name: Safe SOS test
description: Test SOS only in a clearly marked safe drill mode or agreed test procedure.
completion_evidence: SOS test received and cancelled safely

name: Peer reciprocity check
description: Verify that both sides have saved/selected each other so sharing works both directions.

name: Record drill result
description: Record participants, success, failures, message delays, stale positions, and action items.
notes: Use results to update readiness score.

name: Fix failures
description: Assign follow-up actions for failed peers, missing batteries, bad settings, or unclear procedures.
